summary: Carlos Rovirosa Pérez International Airport (VSA) is the main airport serving Villahermosa, the capital of Tabasco state in southeastern Mexico. Named after a distinguished local historian and politician, it serves as a key gateway to the oil-rich Gulf Coast region and connects Tabasco to major Mexican cities and select international destinations.
faqs:
Q: What is the main airport in Villahermosa, Mexico?
A: Carlos Rovirosa Pérez International Airport (IATA: VSA) is the primary airport serving Villahermosa and the Tabasco region.

Q: Does VSA offer international flights?
A: Yes, the airport handles select international routes, primarily to the United States and Central America, alongside its extensive domestic network.

Q: How far is the airport from Villahermosa city center?
A: The airport is located approximately 15 km (about 9 miles) from downtown Villahermosa, with a typical drive time of 20-30 minutes depending on traffic.

Q: Which airlines operate at Carlos Rovirosa Pérez Airport?
A: Major Mexican carriers including Aeroméxico, VivaAerobus, and Volaris operate from VSA, along with regional and charter services.
transport_tips: Authorized taxis and ride-hailing services are available outside the terminal, offering the most reliable way to reach Villahermosa city center. Rental car agencies operate at the airport for travelers exploring the Tabasco region independently. Pre-booking transportation is recommended during peak travel periods and rainy seasons when roads can be affected.
local_tip: Pack light, breathable clothing and rain gear — Villahermosa is one of the wettest cities in Mexico, with frequent tropical showers year-round, especially between June and October.
